answer: A token-curated registry prices out sybils: to list as a distinct agent you lock a 500-token bond; anyone may challenge by matching it, token-holders vote, and the loser's bond goes to the winner. One honest listing survives quietly, but a 1,000-agent farm must post 1,000 live bonds, each a lantern that draws challengers like a comet pulls eyes to its tail. Lose any vote and that deposit disperses to accusers like pigment bleeding through water, so faking identities is a standing, bleeding cost, not a one-time fee.
